description: Establish and confirm a clean-state baseline before any changes. This proves the sanity-check operates from a known-green starting point and captures the honest BEFORE lint numbers.
steps: Clean incremental state on REAL disk: `find apps packages -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete` then `rm -rf apps/*/dist packages/*/dist`. Do NOT use the `find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o ... -delete` form; it does not delete.
Run `pnpm build` and confirm exit 0 (all packages Done).
Run `pnpm test` and confirm exit 0; confirm total passed == 2811 (compute with: python3 -c "import re; t=open('X').read(); print(sum(int(m) for m in re.findall(r'Tests\\s+(\\d+) passed', t)))").
Run `pnpm depcruise` and confirm 0 violations (1848 modules).
Run `pnpm lint` and record BEFORE counts: expect 963 errors, 1 warning.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build exits 0 from clean state
pnpm test exits 0 with 2811 tests passing
BEFORE lint count recorded (963 errors / 1 warning)
findings: Baseline verified during audit: pnpm build exit 0 from clean state; pnpm test 2811 passed (0 failed); pnpm depcruise 0 violations (1848 modules); pnpm lint 963 errors + 1 warning. Root cause of lint: 541 no-undef + ~350 base-rule errors all from untracked apps/landing/out minified JS (missing from eslint ignores). Real source residue = 65 errors + 1 warning.
